dialogue:

Eric: Is this his only stand-up?
Rob: Idk. I'll check.
Eric: Sure.
Rob: Turns out no! There are some of his stand-ups on youtube.
Eric: Gr8! I'll watch them now!
Rob: Me too!
Eric: MACHINE!
Rob: MACHINE!
Eric: TTYL?
Rob: Sure :)

dialogue:
Lenny: Babe, can you help me with something?
Bob: Sure, what's up?
Lenny: Which one should I pick?
Bob: Send me photos
Lenny:  <file_photo>
Lenny:  <file_photo>
Lenny:  <file_photo>
Bob: I like the first ones best
Lenny: But I already have purple trousers. Does it make sense to have two pairs?
Bob: I have four black pairs :D :D
Lenny: yeah, but shouldn't I pick a different color?
Bob: what matters is what you'll give you the most outfit options
Lenny: So I guess I'll buy the first or the third pair then
Bob: Pick the best quality then
Lenny: ur right, thx
Bob: no prob :)

semantic_grounding.speaker: Bob

semantic_grounding.evidence: Pick the best quality then

semantic_grounding.speaker: Lenny
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Lenny accepts Bob's final instruction, acknowledging the advice is correct.
semantic_grounding.evidence: ur right, thx

semantic_grounding.speaker: Bob

dialogue:
Will: hey babe, what do you want for dinner tonight?
Emma:  gah, don't even worry about it tonight
Will: what do you mean? everything ok?
Emma: not really, but it's ok, don't worry about cooking though, I'm not hungry
Will: Well what time will you be home?
Emma: soon, hopefully
Will: you sure? Maybe you want me to pick you up?
Emma: no no it's alright. I'll be home soon, i'll tell you when I get home. 
Will: Alright, love you. 
Emma: love you too.
reference_english_summary: Emma will be home soon and she will let Will know.
reference_chinese_summary: 艾玛很快就会回家，而且她会告诉威尔。

semantic_grounding.speaker: Will
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Will is asking Emma to express her food preference for the evening.
semantic_grounding.evidence: hey babe, what do you want for dinner tonight?

semantic_grounding.speaker: Emma
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Emma refuses the suggestion to cook/eat together by stating she is not hungry and does not want Will to worry about dinner preparations.
semantic_grounding.evidence: gah, don't even worry about it tonight

semantic_grounding.speaker: Will
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Will seeks to resolve the ambiguity in Emma's refusal to determine if there is an underlying problem.
semantic_grounding.evidence: what do you mean? everything ok?

semantic_grounding.speaker: Emma
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Emma confirms she is not in a good mood ('not really') but explicitly reiterates that Will should not cook ('don't worry about cooking though') because she has no appetite.
semantic_grounding.evidence: not really, but it's ok, don't worry about cooking though, I'm not hungry

semantic_grounding.speaker: Will
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Will shifts focus from dinner to logistics, proposing to pick Emma up to ensure she gets home safely.
semantic_grounding.evidence: Maybe you want me to pick you up?

semantic_grounding.speaker: Emma
semantic_grounding.speech_act: Rejection of Proposal / Assertion of Independence
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Emma rejects the offer to be picked up, asserting she will manage her own arrival home.
semantic_grounding.evidence: no no it's alright. I'll be home soon, i'll tell you when I get home.

summary_points: Emma refuses Will's offer to cook dinner, stating she is not hungry and asks him not to worry about food preparations.
Emma rejects Will's proposal to be picked up, asserting she will drive herself home and will notify him upon arrival.

dialogue:
Ollie: Hi , are you in Warsaw
Jane: yes, just back! Btw are you free for diner the 19th?
Ollie: nope!
Jane: and the  18th?
Ollie: nope, we have this party and you must be there, remember?
Jane: oh right! i lost my calendar..  thanks for reminding me
Ollie: we have lunch this week?
Jane: with pleasure!
Ollie: friday?
Jane: ok
Jane: what do you mean " we don't have any more whisky!" lol..
Ollie: what!!!
Jane: you just call me and the all thing i heard was that sentence about whisky... what's wrong with you?
Ollie: oh oh... very strange! i have to be carefull may be there is some spy in my mobile! lol
Jane: dont' worry, we'll check on friday.
Ollie: don't forget to bring some sun with you
Jane: I can't wait to be in Morocco..
Ollie: enjoy and see you friday
Jane: sorry Ollie, i'm very busy, i won't have time for lunch  tomorrow, but may be at 6pm after my courses?this trip to Morocco was so nice, but time consuming!
Ollie: ok for tea!
Jane: I'm on my way..
Ollie: tea is ready, did you bring the pastries?
Jane: I already ate them all... see you in a minute
Ollie: ok
reference_english_summary: Jane is in Warsaw. Ollie and Jane has a party. Jane lost her calendar. They will get a lunch this week on Friday. Ollie accidentally called Jane and talked about whisky. Jane cancels lunch. They'll meet for a tea at 6 pm.
reference_chinese_summary: 简在华沙，她和奥利有个聚会。她把重要的日子忘了，本来他们周五会共进午餐。但是奥利无意间给简打了个电话，聊起了威士忌。于是简取消了午餐。下午6点他们见面喝茶。

semantic_grounding.speaker: Jane
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Jane is not actually asking about the whisky; she is expressing frustration that Ollie's previous message was misinterpreted or that the topic of whisky was brought up unexpectedly, implying a need to disambiguate the conversation flow.
semantic_grounding.evidence: what do you mean " we don't have any more whisky!" lol..

semantic_grounding.speaker: Ollie
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Ollie is rejecting the premise of the 'spy' accusation by attributing the confusion to his own carelessness rather than a security threat, effectively disambiguating the situation as a simple misunderstanding.
semantic_grounding.evidence: oh oh... very strange! i have to be carefull may be there is some spy in my mobile! lol

semantic_grounding.speaker: Jane
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Jane is refusing the lunch invitation for 'tomorrow' (implied by context of busy schedule) but simultaneously proposing a specific alternative time (6pm) to resolve the scheduling conflict.
semantic_grounding.evidence: sorry Ollie, i'm very busy, i won't have time for lunch tomorrow, but may be at 6pm after my courses?

semantic_grounding.speaker: Ollie
semantic_grounding.intended_meaning: Ollie accepts the modified plan (shifting from lunch to tea) and confirms the new arrangement, resolving the ambiguity of the meal type and timing.
semantic_grounding.evidence: ok for tea!

summary_points: Jane clarified that her previous message about lacking whisky was a joke, not a serious inquiry, resolving the misunderstanding regarding the topic.
Jane declined the lunch invitation for tomorrow due to a busy schedule but proposed an alternative meeting time at 6pm.
Ollie accepted the proposed change, agreeing to meet for tea at 6pm instead of lunch.
